'''Gearshift''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], he was part of the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] sent with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Kenobi and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to search for the missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] in the catacombs under the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]]. However, Gearshift was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with another [[Gearshift's comrade|clone]] by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] when the pair attempted to return to the surface and call [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] for reinforcements.

==Biography==
Gearshift was the taken name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="LoT" /> Like all [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] he was a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] during the war, was lost from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] control and new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid factories]] were built by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] ruler [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. The Republic sent a task force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to recapture Geonosis and destroy the factories. Gearshift, serving under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], was part of the Republic troops. After successfully landing on Geonosis, the Republic destroyed the prime factory of the Geonosians, although Poggle escaped. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] who was searching for Poggle went missing and Gearshift and his [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] accompanied Kenobi, Skywalker and Cody to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]], where Unduli was last contacted.

Upon arriving at the temple, the group soon found the [[Death/Legends|dead]] body of a [[Buzz/Legends|clone trooper]] who had accompanied Unduli as well as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Intent on finding Unduli, Skywalker, Kenobi, Cody, Gearshift and the other troopers entered the caverns through the temple's entrance, using lightsabers and headlamps to light the way. While approaching farther under the temple, Unduli contacted Kenobi and hailed him not to follow her. Kenobi, however, insisted on searching further for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Soon after Gearshift and the group encountered undead Geonosian [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] and were unable to kill them. Soon several troopers were killed and Kenobi ordered a retreat. After taking down the tunnel's support, Kenobi tried to contact Mundi via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] for reinforcements. Because the group was too deep underground to get a signal, Kenobi sent Gearshift and a fellow clone back to the surface to contact Mundi. Gearshift and his comrade were soon surrounded by undead Geonosians and quickly killed.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I won't be unhappy to get out from under all this dirt, this place gives me the shivers|Gearshift talking about the catacombs|<ref name="LoT" />}}
Gearshift obeyed the orders given to him by General Kenobi. He was glad to get back to surface when ordered so, because he found the Progate Temple's tunnels creepy. In combat he used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and wore [[orange]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gearshift first appeared in [[Legacy of Terror]], an episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|the second season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the Clone Wars TV series]]. Like all clone troopers in the series, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Legacy of Terror">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode207.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Legacy of Terror}}</ref>
